title.quote: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia National Artificial Intelligence Policy

issuing_body.quote: The National AI Policy has been developed under the leadership of the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute. It will take effect following approval by the Council of Ministers

legal_force.quote: It will take effect following approval by the Council of Ministers, in alignment with Council of Ministers Regulation No. 510/2022.

judgment.status_reasoning: The policy text says it takes effect on Council of Ministers approval; a tracker stored this run reports approval on 27 June 2024 and OECD.AI lists it as active. No later event is in the stored text.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Borderline national strategy/policy with risk-governance content; in scope as already recorded.

open_questions: The stored official-domain copy (mint.gov.et) was not available; evidence rests on the OECD.AI-hosted PDF.
27 June 2024 approval date rests on a tracker page (secondary); the document gives only June 2024.
